ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓر كِتَٰبٌ أُحْكِمَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ
en: (1) Alif, Lām, Rā.[546] [This is] a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Aware[547]
enNotes:
[546]- See footnote to 2:1.
[547]- Refer to footnotes of 6:18.
tr: Alif lām rā, kitābun uḥkimat āyātuhū thumma fuṣṣilat mil ladun ḥakīmin khabīr

ar: أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنَّنِى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ
en: (2) [Through a messenger, saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings,"
tr: Allā taʿbudū illallāh, innanī lakum minhu nadhīruw wabashīr

ar: وَأَنِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُم مَّتَٰعًا حَسَنًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِى فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهُۥ وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ كَبِيرٍ
en: (3) And [saying], "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor [i.e., reward]. But if you turn away, then indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great Day.
tr: Waʾanistaghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yumattiʿkum matāʿan ḥasanan ilā ajalim musammaw wayuʾti kulla dhī faḍlin faḍlah, waʾin tawallaw faʾinnī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin kabīr

ar: إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (4) To Allāh is your return, and He is over all things competent."
tr: Ilallāhi marjiʿukum, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُوا۟ مِنْهُ أَلَا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
en: (5) Unquestionably, they [i.e., the disbelievers] turn away their breasts to hide themselves from him. Unquestionably, [even] when they cover themselves in their clothing, He [i.e., Allāh] knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr: Alā innahum yathnūna ṣudūrahum liyastakhfū minh, alā ḥīna yastaghshūna thiyābahum yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿlinūn, innahū ʿalīmum bidhātiṣ-ṣudūr

ar: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا كُلٌّ فِى كِتَٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (6) And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allāh is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage.[548] All is in a clear register.
enNotes: [548]- Before birth and after death.
tr: Wamā min dābbatin fil-arḍi illā ʿalallāhi rizquhā wayaʿlamu mustaqarrahā wamustawdaʿahā, kullun fī kitābim mubīn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْمَآءِ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَلَئِن قُلْتَ إِنَّكُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْمَوْتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (7) And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and His Throne had been upon water - that He might test you as to which of you is best in deed. But if you say, "Indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "This is not but obvious magic."
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmiw wakāna ʿarshuhū ʿalal-māʾi liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalā, walaʾin qulta innakum mabʿūthūna mim baʿdil-mawti layaqūlannal-ladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā siḥrum mubīn

ar: وَلَئِنْ أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ مَّعْدُودَةٍ لَّيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحْبِسُهُۥٓ أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (8) And if We hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say,[549] "What detains it?" Unquestionably, on the Day it comes to them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
enNotes: [549]- In ridicule and disbelief.
tr: Walaʾin akhkharnā ʿanhumul-ʿadhāba ilā ummatim maʿdūdatil layaqūlunna mā yaḥbisuh, alā yawma yaʾtīhim laysa maṣrūfan ʿanhum waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn

ar: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَٰهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَـُٔوسٌ كَفُورٌ
en: (9) And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful.
tr: Walaʾin adhaqnal-insāna minnā raḥmatan thumma nazaʿnāhā minh, innahū layaʾūsun kafūr

ar: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَٰهُ نَعْمَآءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتُ عَنِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ
en: (10) But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful -
tr: Walaʾin adhaqnāhu naʿmāʾa baʿda ḍarrāʾa massathu layaqūlanna dhahabas-sayyiʾātu ʿannī, innahū lafariḥun fakhūr

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
en: (11) Except for those who are patient and do righteous deeds; those will have forgiveness and great reward.
tr: Illal-ladhīna ṣabarū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāt, ulāʾika lahum maghfiratuw waʾajrun kabīr

ar: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَضَآئِقٌۢ بِهِۦ صَدْرُكَ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُۥ مَلَكٌ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ نَذِيرٌ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
en: (12) Then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you,[550] or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?" But you are only a warner. And Allāh is Disposer of all things.
enNotes: [550]- Knowing of the Prophet's difficulties, Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) urges him to patience, certain that he would not fail to convey the message in its entirety.
tr: Falaʿallaka tārikum baʿḍa mā yūḥā ilayka waḍāʾiqum bihī ṣadruka ay yaqūlū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi kanzun aw jāʾa maʿahū malak, innamā anta nadhīr, wallāhu ʿalā kulli shayʾiw wakīl

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِّثْلِهِۦ مُفْتَرَيَٰتٍ وَٱدْعُوا۟ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (13) Or do they say, "He invented it"? Say, "Then bring ten sūrahs like it that have been invented and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allāh, if you should be truthful."
tr: Am yaqūlūnaftarāh, qul faʾtū biʿashri suwarim mithlihī muftarayātiw wadʿū manistaṭaʿtum min dūnillāhi in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ بِعِلْمِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
en: (14) And if they do not respond to you - then know that it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was revealed with the knowledge of Allāh[551] and that there is no deity except Him. Then,[552] would you [not] be Muslims?
enNotes:
[551]- i.e., that knowledge which no one possesses except Him (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).
[552]- After having been convinced by such evidence.
tr: Faʾillam yastajībū lakum faʿlamū annamā unzila biʿilmillāhi waʾal lā ilāha illā huw, fahal antum muslimūn

ar: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فِيهَا وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يُبْخَسُونَ
en: (15) Whoever desires the life of this world and its adornments - We fully repay them for their deeds therein,[553] and they therein will not be deprived.
enNotes: [553]- i.e., during worldly life.
tr: Man kāna yurīdul-ḥayātad-dunyā wazīnatahā nuwaffi ilayhim aʿmālahum fīhā wahum fīhā lā yubkhasūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارُ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوا۟ فِيهَا وَبَٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (16) Those are the ones for whom there is not in the Hereafter but the Fire. And lost is what they did therein,[554] and worthless is what they used to do.
enNotes: [554]- i.e., during worldly life.
tr: Ulāʾikal-ladhīna laysa lahum fil-ākhirati illan-nār, waḥabiṭa mā ṣanaʿū fīhā wabāṭilum mā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْهُ وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ فَٱلنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُۥ فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (17) So is one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his Lord [like the aforementioned]? And a witness[555] from Him follows it,[556] and before it was the Scripture of Moses to lead and as mercy. Those [believers in the former revelations] believe in it [i.e., the Qur’ān]. But whoever disbelieves in it from the [various] factions - the Fire is his promised destination. So be not in doubt about it. Indeed, it is the truth from your Lord, but most of the people do not believe.
enNotes:
[555]- Referring to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) or to the angel Gabriel.
[556]- Testifying to its truth. Additionally, it can mean "recites it," i.e., the Qur’ān.
tr: Afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatim mir rabbihī wayatlūhu shāhidum minhu wamin qablihī kitābu mūsā imāmaw waraḥmah, ulāʾika yuʾminūna bih, wamay yakfur bihī minal-aḥzābi fan-nāru mawʿiduhū falā taku fī miryatim minhu innahul-ḥaqqu mir rabbika walākinna aktharan-nāsi lā yuʾminūn

ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (18) And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allāh? Those will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied against their Lord." Unquestionably, the curse of Allāh is upon the wrongdoers
tr: Waman aẓlamu mimmaniftarā ʿalallāhi kadhibā, ulāʾika yuʿraḍūna ʿalā rabbihim wayaqūlul-ashhādu hāʾulāʾil-ladhīna kadhabū ʿalā rabbihim, alā laʿnatullāhi ʿalaẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
en: (19) Who averted [people] from the way of Allāh and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they, concerning the Hereafter, were disbelievers.
tr: Al-ladhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīlillāhi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajā, wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ مُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يُبْصِرُونَ
en: (20) Those were not causing failure [to Allāh] on earth, nor did they have besides Allāh any protectors. For them the punishment will be multiplied. They were not able to hear, nor did they see.[557]
enNotes: [557]- They refused to listen to the truth or to perceive it.
tr: Ulāʾika lam yakūnū muʿjizīna fil-arḍi wamā kāna lahum min dūnillāhi min awliyāʾ, yuḍāʿafu lahumul-ʿadhāb, mā kānū yastaṭīʿūnas-samʿa wamā kānū yubṣirūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
en: (21) Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
tr: Ulāʾikal-ladhīna khasirū anfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūn

ar: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
en: (22) Assuredly, it is they in the Hereafter who will be the greatest losers.
tr: Lā jarama annahum fil-ākhirati humul-akhsarūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَأَخْبَتُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (23) Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds and humbled themselves to their Lord - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide eternally therein.
tr: Innal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti waʾakhbatū ilā rabbihim ulāʾika aṣḥābul-jannah, hum fīhā khālidūn

ar: مَثَلُ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْأَصَمِّ وَٱلْبَصِيرِ وَٱلسَّمِيعِ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
en: (24) The example of the two parties is like the blind and deaf, and the seeing and hearing. Are they equal in comparison? Then, will you not remember?
tr: Mathalul-farīqayni kal-aʿmā wal-aṣammi wal-baṣīri was-samīʿ, hal yastawiyāni mathalā, afalā tadhakkarūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (25) And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner
tr: Walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihī innī lakum nadhīrum mubīn

ar: أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
en: (26) That you not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful day."
tr: Al lā taʿbudū illallāh, innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin alīm

ar: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا نَرَىٰكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًا مِّثْلَنَا وَمَا نَرَىٰكَ ٱتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِىَ ٱلرَّأْىِ وَمَا نَرَىٰ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍۭ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَٰذِبِينَ
en: (27) So the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "We do not see you but as a man like ourselves, and we do not see you followed except by those who are the lowest of us [and] at first suggestion.[558] And we do not see in you over us any merit; rather, we think you are liars."
enNotes: [558]- i.e., without any thought or hesitation.
tr: Faqālal-malaʾul-ladhīna kafarū min qawmihī mā narāka illā basharam mithlanā wamā narākattabaʿaka illal-ladhīna hum arādhilunā bādiyar-raʾy, wamā narā lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlim bal naẓunnukum kādhibīn

ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَءَاتَىٰنِى رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِهِۦ فَعُمِّيَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا وَأَنتُمْ لَهَا كَٰرِهُونَ
en: (28) He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it?
tr: Qāla yāqawmi araʾaytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatim mir rabbī waʾātānī raḥmatam min ʿindihī faʿummiyat ʿalaykum, anulzimukumūhā waʾantum lahā kārihūn

ar: وَيَٰقَوْمِ لَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَالًا إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَٰكِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ
en: (29) And O my people, I ask not of you for it any wealth. My reward is not but from Allāh. And I am not one to drive away those who have believed. Indeed, they will meet their Lord, but I see that you are a people behaving ignorantly.
tr: Wayāqawmi lā asʾalukum ʿalayhi mālā, in ajriya illā ʿalallāhi wamā ana biṭāridil-ladhīna āmanū, innahum mulāqū rabbihim walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūn

ar: وَيَٰقَوْمِ مَن يَنصُرُنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِن طَرَدتُّهُمْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
en: (30) And O my people, who would protect me from Allāh if I drove them away? Then will you not be reminded?
tr: Wayāqawmi may yanṣurunī minallāhi in ṭarattuhum, afalā tadhakkarūn

ar: وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ إِنِّى مَلَكٌ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِىٓ أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَن يُؤْتِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرًا ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (31) And I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allāh or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel, nor do I say of those upon whom your eyes look down that Allāh will never grant them any good. Allāh is most knowing of what is within their souls. Indeed, I would then be among the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust]."
tr: Walā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāʾinullāhi walā aʿlamul-ghayba walā aqūlu innī malakuw walā aqūlu lilladhīna tazdarī aʿyunukum lay yuʾtiyahumullāhu khayrā, allāhu aʿlamu bimā fī anfusihim, innī idhal laminaẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰنُوحُ قَدْ جَٰدَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَٰلَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
en: (32) They said, "O Noah, you have disputed [i.e., opposed] us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful."
tr: Qālū yānūḥu qad jādaltanā faʾaktharta jidālanā faʾtinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn

ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ إِن شَآءَ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
en: (33) He said, "Allāh will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure.
tr: Qāla innamā yaʾtīkum bihillāhu in shāʾa wamā antum bimuʿjizīn

ar: وَلَا يَنفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِىٓ إِنْ أَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَنصَحَ لَكُمْ إِن كَانَ ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَن يُغْوِيَكُمْ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (34) And my advice will not benefit you - although I wished to advise you - if Allāh should intend to put you in error. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned."
tr: Walā yanfaʿukum nuṣḥī in arattu an anṣaḥa lakum in kānallāhu yurīdu ay yughwiyakum, huwa rabbukum, waʾilayhi turjaʿūn

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَعَلَىَّ إِجْرَامِى وَأَنَا۠ بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ
en: (35) Or do they say [about Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit."
tr: Am yaqūlūnaftarāh, qul iniftaraytuhū faʿalayya ijrāmī waʾana barīʾum mimmā tujrimūn

ar: وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ أَنَّهُۥ لَن يُؤْمِنَ مِن قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَن قَدْ ءَامَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
en: (36) And it was revealed to Noah that, "No one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing.
tr: Waʾūḥiya ilā nūḥin annahū lay yuʾmina min qawmika illā man qad āmana falā tabtaʾis bimā kānū yafʿalūn

ar: وَٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
en: (37) And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned."
tr: Waṣnaʿil-fulka biʾaʿyuninā wawaḥyinā walā tukhāṭibnī fil-ladhīna ẓalamū, innahum mughraqūn

ar: وَيَصْنَعُ ٱلْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُ قَالَ إِن تَسْخَرُوا۟ مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ
en: (38) And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule.
tr: Wayaṣnaʿul-fulk, wakullamā marra ʿalayhi malaʾum min qawmihī sakhirū minh, qāla in taskharū minnā faʾinnā naskharu minkum kamā taskharūn

ar: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
en: (39) And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]."
tr: Fasawfa taʿlamūna may yaʾtīhi ʿadhābuy yukhzīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābum muqīm

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا ٱحْمِلْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَمَآ ءَامَنَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ
en: (40) [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed,[559] We said, "Load upon it [i.e., the ship] of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word [i.e., decree] has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few.
enNotes: [559]- As a sign to Noah of the imminence of the flood. The tannūr is a large, rounded oven. The word can also mean the earth's lowlands.
tr: Ḥattā idhā jāʾa amrunā wafārat-tannūru qulnaḥmil fīhā min kullin zawjaynithnayni waʾahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhil-qawlu waman āman, wamā āmana maʿahū illā qalīl

ar: وَقَالَ ٱرْكَبُوا۟ فِيهَا بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ مَجْر۪ىٰهَا وَمُرْسَىٰهَآ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
en: (41) And [Noah] said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allāh [are] its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
tr: Waqālarkabū fīhā bismillāhi majrēhā wamursāhā, inna rabbī laghafūrur raḥīm

ar: وَهِىَ تَجْرِى بِهِمْ فِى مَوْجٍ كَٱلْجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ٱبْنَهُۥ وَكَانَ فِى مَعْزِلٍ يَٰبُنَىَّ ٱرْكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (42) And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers."
tr: Wahiya tajrī bihim fī mawjin kal-jibāl, wanādā nūḥunibnahū wakāna fī maʿziliy yābunayyarkam maʿanā walā takum maʿal-kāfirīn

ar: قَالَ سَـَٔاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِى مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُغْرَقِينَ
en: (43) [But] he said, "I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [Noah] said, "There is no protector today from the decree of Allāh, except for whom He gives mercy." And the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned.
tr: Qāla saʾāwī ilā jabaliy yaʿṣimunī minal-māʾ, qāla lā ʿāṣimal-yawma min amrillāhi illā mar raḥim, waḥāla baynahumal-mawju fakāna minal-mughraqīn

ar: وَقِيلَ يَٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (44) And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."
tr: Waqīla yā arḍublaʿī māʾaki wayāsamāʾu aqliʿī waghīḍal-māʾu waquḍiyal-amru wastawat ʿalal-jūdiyyi waqīla buʿdal lil-qawmiẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
en: (45) And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!"
tr: Wanādā nūḥur rabbahū faqāla rabbi innabnī min ahlī, waʾinna waʿdakal-ḥaqqu waʾanta aḥkamul-ḥākimīn

ar: قَالَ يَٰنُوحُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ إِنَّهُۥ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَٰلِحٍ فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ إِنِّىٓ أَعِظُكَ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
en: (46) He said, "O Noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [one whose] work was other than righteous, so ask Me not for that about which you have no knowledge. Indeed, I advise you, lest you be among the ignorant."
tr: Qāla yānūḥu innahū laysa min ahlik, innahū ʿamalun ghayru ṣāliḥin falā tasʾalni mā laysa laka bihī ʿilm, innī aʿiẓuka an takūna minal-jāhilīn

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِى وَتَرْحَمْنِىٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
en: (47) [Noah] said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers."
tr: Qāla rabbi innī aʿūdhu bika an asʾalaka mā laysa lī bihī ʿilm, waʾillā taghfir lī watarḥamnī akum minal-khāsirīn

ar: قِيلَ يَٰنُوحُ ٱهْبِطْ بِسَلَٰمٍ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكَٰتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّمَّن مَّعَكَ وَأُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: (48) It was said, "O Noah, disembark in security from Us and blessings upon you and upon nations [descending] from those with you. But other nations [of them] We will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from Us a painful punishment."
tr: Qīla yānūḥuhbiṭ bisalāmim minnā wabarakātin ʿalayka waʿalā umamim mimmam maʿak, waʾumamun sanumattiʿuhum thumma yamassuhum minnā ʿadhābun alīm

ar: تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَآ إِلَيْكَ مَا كُنتَ تَعْلَمُهَآ أَنتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِن قَبْلِ هَٰذَا فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ ٱلْعَٰقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
en: (49) That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muḥammad]. You knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. So be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous.
tr: Tilka min ambāʾil-ghaybi nūḥīhā ilayk, mā kunta taʿlamuhā anta walā qawmuka min qabli hādhā, faṣbir, innal-ʿāqibata lil-muttaqīn

ar: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ
en: (50) And to ʿAad [We sent] their brother Hūd. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors [of falsehood].
tr: Waʾilā ʿādin akhāhum hūdā, qāla yāqawmiʿbudullāha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruh, in antum illā muftarūn

ar: يَٰقَوْمِ لَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِىٓ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (51) O my people, I do not ask you for it [i.e., my advice] any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason?
tr: Yāqawmi lā asʾalukum ʿalayhi ajrā, in ajriya illā ʿalal-ladhī faṭaranī, afalā taʿqilūn

ar: وَيَٰقَوْمِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
en: (52) And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. And do not turn away, [being] criminals."
tr: Wayāqawmistaghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yursilis-samāʾa ʿalaykum midrāraw wayazidkum quwwatan ilā quwwatikum walā tatawallaw mujrimīn

ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰهُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِىٓ ءَالِهَتِنَا عَن قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (53) They said, "O Hūd, you have not brought us clear evidence, and we are not ones to leave our gods on your say-so. Nor are we believers in you.
tr: Qālū yāhūdu mā jiʾtanā bibayyinatiw wamā naḥnu bitārikī ālihatinā ʿan qawlika wamā naḥnu laka bimuʾminīn

ar: إِن نَّقُولُ إِلَّا ٱعْتَرَىٰكَ بَعْضُ ءَالِهَتِنَا بِسُوٓءٍ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ وَٱشْهَدُوٓا۟ أَنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
en: (54) We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil [i.e., insanity]." He said, "Indeed, I call Allāh to witness, and witness [yourselves] that I am free from whatever you associate with Allāh
tr: In naqūlu illaʿtarāka baʿḍu ālihatinā bisūʾ, qāla innī ushhidullāha washhadū annī barīʾum mimmā tushrikūn

ar: مِن دُونِهِۦ فَكِيدُونِى جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ
en: (55) Other than Him. So plot against me all together; then do not give me respite.
tr: Min dūnihī fakīdūnī jamīʿan thumma lā tunẓirūn

ar: إِنِّى تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآ إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (56) Indeed, I have relied upon Allāh, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds it by its forelock [i.e., controls it]. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight.
tr: Innī tawakkaltu ʿalallāhi rabbī warabbikum, mā min dābbatin illā huwa ākhidhum bināṣiyatihā, inna rabbī ʿalā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm

ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَيْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّى قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُۥ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
en: (57) But if you turn away, then I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian."[560]
enNotes: [560]- Protecting and preserving the existence and attributes of His creations.
tr: Faʾin tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum mā ursiltu bihī ilaykum, wayastakhlifu rabbī qawman ghayrakum, walā taḍurrūnahū shayʾā, inna rabbī ʿalā kulli shayʾin ḥafīẓ

ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
en: (58) And when Our command came, We saved Hūd and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us; and We saved them from a harsh punishment.
tr: Walammā jāʾa amrunā najjaynā hūdaw wal-ladhīna āmanū maʿahū biraḥmatim minnā, wanajjaynāhum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓ

ar: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ جَحَدُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا۟ رُسُلَهُۥ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
en: (59) And that was ʿAad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant.
tr: Watilka ʿād, jaḥadū biʾāyāti rabbihim waʿaṣaw rusulahū wattabaʿū amra kulli jabbārin ʿanīd

ar: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَلَآ إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ
en: (60) And they were [therefore] followed in this world with a curse and [as well] on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, ʿAad denied their Lord; then away with ʿAad, the people of Hūd.
tr: Waʾutbiʿū fī hādhihid-dunyā laʿnataw wayawmal-qiyāmah, alā inna ʿādan kafarū rabbahum, alā buʿdal liʿādin qawmi hūd

ar: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ
en: (61) And to Thamūd [We sent] their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."
tr: Waʾilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥā, qāla yāqawmiʿbudullāha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruh, huwa anshaʾakum minal-arḍi wastaʿmarakum fīhā fastaghfirūhu thumma tūbū ilayh, inna rabbī qarībum mujīb

ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰصَٰلِحُ قَدْ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَٰذَآ أَتَنْهَىٰنَآ أَن نَّعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ
en: (62) They said, "O Ṣāliḥ, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."
tr: Qālū yāṣāliḥu qad kunta fīnā marjuwwan qabla hādhā atanhānā an naʿbuda mā yaʿbudu ābāʾunā waʾinnanā lafī shakkim mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi murīb

ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَءَاتَىٰنِى مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَن يَنصُرُنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُۥ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِى غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ
en: (63) He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has given me mercy from Himself, who would protect me from Allāh if I disobeyed Him? So you would not increase me except in loss.
tr: Qāla yāqawmi araʾaytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatim mir rabbī, waʾātānī minhu raḥmatan famay yanṣurunī minallāhi in ʿaṣaytuh, famā tazīdūnanī ghayra takhsīr

ar: وَيَٰقَوْمِ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ ءَايَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِىٓ أَرْضِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ
en: (64) And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allāh - [she is] to you a sign. So let her feed upon Allāh's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment."
tr: Wayāqawmi hādhihī nāqatullāhi lakum āyatan fadharūhā taʾkul fī arḍillāhi walā tamassūhā bisūʾin fayaʾkhudhakum ʿadhābun qarīb

ar: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فِى دَارِكُمْ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ذَٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ
en: (65) But they hamstrung her, so he said, "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied [i.e., unfailing]."
tr: Faʿaqarūhā faqāla tamattaʿū fī dārikum thalāthata ayyām, dhālika waʿdun ghayru makdhūb

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَٰلِحًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْىِ يَوْمِئِذٍ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
en: (66) So when Our command came, We saved Ṣāliḥ and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and [saved them] from the disgrace of that day.[561] Indeed, it is your Lord who is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
enNotes: [561]- The day of Thamūd's destruction.
tr: Falammā jāʾa amrunā najjaynā ṣāliḥaw wal-ladhīna āmanū maʿahū biraḥmatim minnā wamin khizyi yawmiʾidh, inna rabbaka huwal-qawiyyul-ʿazīz

ar: وَأَخَذَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَٰرِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
en: (67) And the shriek[562] seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
enNotes: [562]- A piercing cry or blast from the sky.
tr: Waʾakhadhal-ladhīna ẓalamuṣ-ṣayḥatu faʾaṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīn

ar: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ أَلَآ إِنَّ ثَمُودَا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّثَمُودَ
en: (68) As if they had never prospered therein. Unquestionably, Thamūd denied their Lord; then, away with Thamūd.
tr: Kaʾal lam yaghnaw fīhā, alā inna thamūda kafarū rabbahum, alā buʿdal lithamūd

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَن جَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ
en: (69) And certainly did Our messengers [i.e., angels] come to Abraham with good tidings; they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and did not delay in bringing [them] a roasted calf.
tr: Walaqad jāʾat rusulunā ibrāhīma bil-bushrā qālū salāmā, qāla salāmun famā labitha an jāʾa biʿijlin ḥanīdh

ar: فَلَمَّا رَءَآ أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
en: (70) But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension.[563] They said, "Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lot."
enNotes: [563]- Traditionally, if a guest refused to eat, it meant that he harbored ill will toward the host or intended him harm.
tr: Falammā raʾā aydiyahum lā taṣilu ilayhi nakirahum waʾawjasa minhum khīfah, qālū lā takhaf innā ursilnā ilā qawmi lūṭ

ar: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَٰهَا بِإِسْحَٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسْحَٰقَ يَعْقُوبَ
en: (71) And his wife was standing, and she smiled.[564] Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.
enNotes: [564]- In pleasure at the news of the forthcoming punishment of the evil people who denied Prophet Lot (upon him be peace).
tr: Wamraʾatuhū qāʾimatun faḍaḥikat fabashsharnāhā biʾisḥāqa wamiw warāʾi isḥāqa yaʿqūb

ar: قَالَتْ يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزٌ وَهَٰذَا بَعْلِى شَيْخًا إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
en: (72) She said, "Woe to me![565] Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!"
enNotes: [565]- An expression of surprise and amazement.
tr: Qālat yāwaylatā aʾalidu waʾana ʿajūzuw wahādhā baʿlī shaykhā, inna hādhā lashayʾun ʿajīb

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ رَحْمَتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَٰتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ إِنَّهُۥ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
en: (73) They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allāh? May the mercy of Allāh and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."
tr: Qālū ataʿjabīna min amrillāhi raḥmatullāhi wabarakātuhū ʿalaykum ahlal-bayt, innahū ḥamīdum majīd

ar: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلرَّوْعُ وَجَآءَتْهُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ يُجَٰدِلُنَا فِى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
en: (74) And when the fright had left Abraham and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue [i.e., plead] with Us[566] concerning the people of Lot.
enNotes: [566]- i.e., with Our angels.
tr: Falammā dhahaba ʿan ibrāhīmar-rawʿu wajāʾathul-bushrā yujādilunā fī qawmi lūṭ

ar: إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّٰهٌ مُّنِيبٌ
en: (75) Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving[567] and [frequently] returning [to Allāh].
enNotes: [567]- i.e., sighing or moaning during supplication out of grief for people and fear of Allāh.
tr: Inna ibrāhīma laḥalīmun awwāhum munīb

ar: يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَآ إِنَّهُۥ قَدْ جَآءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَإِنَّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ
en: (76) [The angels said], "O Abraham, give up this [plea]. Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled."
tr: Yā ibrāhīmu aʿriḍ ʿan hādhā, innahū qad jāʾa amru rabbik, waʾinnahum ātīhim ʿadhābun ghayru mardūd

ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ
en: (77) And when Our messengers, [the angels], came to Lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort[568] and said, "This is a trying day."
enNotes: [568]- Prophet Lot feared for the safety and honor of his guests.
tr: Walammā jāʾat rusulunā lūṭan sīʾa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿaw waqāla hādhā yawmun ʿaṣīb

ar: وَجَآءَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِى هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِى ضَيْفِىٓ أَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيدٌ
en: (78) And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds.[569] He said, "O my people, these are my daughters;[570] they are purer for you. So fear Allāh and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?"
enNotes:
[569]- Referring to their practice of sodomy and homosexual rape of males.
[570]- i.e., the women of his community who were available for marriage.
tr: Wajāʾahū qawmuhū yuhraʿūna ilayh, wamin qablu kānū yaʿmalūnas-sayyiʾāt, qāla yāqawmi hāʾulāʾi banātī hunna aṭharu lakum fattaqullāha walā tukhzūni fī ḍayfī, alaysa minkum rajulur rashīd

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِى بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ
en: (79) They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters [i.e., women] any claim [i.e., desire], and indeed, you know what we want."
tr: Qālū laqad ʿalimta mā lanā fī banātika min ḥaqq, waʾinnaka lataʿlamu mā nurīd

ar: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ
en: (80) He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support."
tr: Qāla law anna lī bikum quwwatan aw āwī ilā ruknin shadīd

ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰلُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكَ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ إِنَّهُۥ مُصِيبُهَا مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ ٱلصُّبْحُ أَلَيْسَ ٱلصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ
en: (81) They [the angels] said, "O Lot, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; [therefore], they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night[571] and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. Is not the morning near?"
enNotes: [571]- i.e., sometime before dawn.
tr: Qālū yālūṭu innā rusulu rabbika lay yaṣilū ilayka faʾasri biʾahlika biqiṭʿim minal-layli walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun illamraʾatak, innahū muṣībuhā mā aṣābahum, inna mawʿidahumuṣ-ṣubḥ, alaysaṣ-ṣubḥu biqarīb

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ مَّنضُودٍ
en: (82) So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]
tr: Falammā jāʾa amrunā jaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā waʾamṭarnā ʿalayhā ḥijāratam min sijjīlim manḍūd

ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ وَمَا هِىَ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ
en: (83) Marked from your Lord. And it [i.e., Allāh's punishment] is not from the wrongdoers [very] far.
tr: Musawwamatan ʿinda rabbik, wamā hiya minaẓ-ẓālimīna bibaʿīd

ar: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ وَلَا تَنقُصُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُم بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُّحِيطٍ
en: (84) And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day.
tr: Waʾilā madyana akhāhum shuʿaybā, qāla yāqawmiʿbudullāha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruh, walā tanquṣul-mikyāla wal-mīzāna innī arākum bikhayriw waʾinnī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmim muḥīṭ

ar: وَيَٰقَوْمِ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
en: (85) And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.
tr: Wayāqawmi awful-mikyāla wal-mīzāna bil-qisṭi walā tabkhasun-nāsa ashyāʾahum walā taʿthaw fil-arḍi mufsidīn

ar: بَقِيَّتُ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ
en: (86) What remains [lawful] from Allāh is best for you, if you would be believers. But I am not a guardian over you."
tr: Baqiyyatullāhi khayrul lakum in kuntum muʾminīn, wamā ana ʿalaykum biḥafīẓ

ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَٰٓؤُا۟ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
en: (87) They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!"[572]
enNotes: [572]- This is a sarcastic description implying the opposite.
tr: Qālū yāshuʿaybu aṣalātuka taʾmuruka an natruka mā yaʿbudu ābāʾunā aw an nafʿala fī amwālinā mā nashāʾ, innaka laʾantal-ḥalīmur-rashīd

ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَرَزَقَنِى مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلْإِصْلَٰحَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِىٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
en: (88) He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...?[573] And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allāh. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.[574]
enNotes:
[573]- The conclusion of the sentence is estimated as "...would it not be my duty to warn you against corruption and disobedience?"
[574]- i.e., I turn to Allāh frequently in supplication and repentance.
tr: Qāla yāqawmi araʾaytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatim mir rabbī warazaqanī minhu rizqan ḥasanaw wamā urīdu an ukhālifakum ilā mā anhākum ʿanh, in urīdu illal-iṣlāḥa mastaṭaʿt, wamā tawfīqī illā billāh, ʿalayhi tawakkaltu waʾilayhi unīb

ar: وَيَٰقَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِىٓ أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثْلُ مَآ أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَٰلِحٍ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٍ
en: (89) And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hūd or the people of Ṣāliḥ. And the people of Lot are not from you far away.
tr: Wayāqawmi lā yajrimannakum shiqāqī ay yuṣībakum mithlu mā aṣāba qawma nūḥin aw qawma hūdin aw qawma ṣāliḥ, wamā qawmu lūṭim minkum bibaʿīd

ar: وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّى رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ
en: (90) And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate."
tr: Wastaghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayh, inna rabbī raḥīmuw wadūd

ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰشُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَٰكَ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ
en: (91) They said, "O Shuʿayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected."
tr: Qālū yāshuʿaybu mā nafqahu kathīram mimmā taqūlu waʾinnā lanarāka fīnā ḍaʿīfā, walawlā rahṭuka larajamnāk, wamā anta ʿalaynā biʿazīz

ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَهْطِىٓ أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَآءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا إِنَّ رَبِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
en: (92) He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allāh? But you put Him behind your backs [in neglect]. Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do.
tr: Qāla yāqawmi arahṭī aʿazzu ʿalaykum minallāh, wattakhadhtumūhu warāʾakum ẓihriyyā, inna rabbī bimā taʿmalūna muḥīṭ

ar: وَيَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَٰمِلٌ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌ وَٱرْتَقِبُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ
en: (93) And O my people, work according to your position; indeed, I am working. You are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. So watch; indeed, I am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]."
tr: Wayāqawmiʿmalū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmil, sawfa taʿlamūna may yaʾtīhi ʿadhābuy yukhzīhi waman huwa kādhib, wartaqibū innī maʿakum raqīb

ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَٰرِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
en: (94) And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
tr: Walammā jāʾa amrunā najjaynā shuʿaybaw wal-ladhīna āmanū maʿahū biraḥmatim minnā, waʾakhadhatil-ladhīna ẓalamuṣ-ṣayḥatu faʾaṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīn

ar: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ
en: (95) As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamūd was taken away.
tr: Kaʾal lam yaghnaw fīhā, alā buʿdal limadyana kamā baʿidat thamūd

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (96) And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority[575]
enNotes: [575]- i.e., evidences from Allāh.
tr: Walaqad arsalnā mūsā biʾāyātinā wasulṭānim mubīn

ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَآ أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ
en: (97) To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not [at all] discerning.
tr: Ilā firʿawna wamalaʾihī fattabaʿū amra firʿawn, wamā amru firʿawna birashīd

ar: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْوِرْدُ ٱلْمَوْرُودُ
en: (98) He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them into the Fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led.
tr: Yaqdumu qawmahū yawmal-qiyāmati faʾawradahumun-nār, wabiʾsal-wirdul-mawrūd

ar: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِۦ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ بِئْسَ ٱلرِّفْدُ ٱلْمَرْفُودُ
en: (99) And they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift[576] which is given.
enNotes: [576]- i.e., the curse which follows them in both worlds.
tr: Waʾutbiʿū fī hādhihī laʿnataw wayawmal-qiyāmah, biʾsar-rifdul-marfūd

ar: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّهُۥ عَلَيْكَ مِنْهَا قَآئِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ
en: (100) That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down].[577]
enNotes: [577]- Their structures have been completely destroyed.
tr: Dhālika min ambāʾil-qurā naquṣṣuhū ʿalayka minhā qāʾimuw waḥaṣīd

ar: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَمَآ أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ ءَالِهَتُهُمُ ٱلَّتِى يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ لَّمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ
en: (101) And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. And they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than Allāh when there came the command of your Lord. And they did not increase them in other than ruin.
tr: Wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin ẓalamū anfusahum famā aghnat ʿanhum ālihatuhumul-latī yadʿūna min dūnillāhi min shayʾil lammā jāʾa amru rabbik, wamā zādūhum ghayra tatbīb

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَآ أَخَذَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَهِىَ ظَٰلِمَةٌ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُۥٓ أَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ
en: (102) And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe.
tr: Wakadhālika akhdhu rabbika idhā akhadhal-qurā wahiya ẓālimah, inna akhdhahū alīmun shadīd

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّجْمُوعٌ لَّهُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّشْهُودٌ
en: (103) Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day [which will be] witnessed.
tr: Inna fī dhālika laʾāyatal liman khāfa ʿadhābal-ākhirah, dhālika yawmum majmūʿul lahun-nāsu wadhālika yawmum mashhūd

ar: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَّعْدُودٍ
en: (104) And We do not delay it except for a limited term.
tr: Wamā nuʾakhkhiruhū illā liʾajalim maʿdūd

ar: يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِىٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ
en: (105) The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous.
tr: Yawma yaʾti lā takallamu nafsun illā biʾidhnih, faminhum shaqiyyuw wasaʿīd

ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ شَقُوا۟ فَفِى ٱلنَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ
en: (106) As for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling.[578]
enNotes: [578]- i.e., their sighs and sobs, resembling the bray of a donkey.
tr: Faʾammal-ladhīna shaqū fafin-nāri lahum fīhā zafīruw washahīq

ar: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
en: (107) [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends.
tr: Khālidīna fīhā mā dāmatis-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shāʾa rabbuk, inna rabbaka faʿʿālul limā yurīd

ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا۟ فَفِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ عَطَآءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ
en: (108) And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted.
tr: Waʾammal-ladhīna suʿidū fafil-jannati khālidīna fīhā mā dāmatis-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shāʾa rabbuk, ʿaṭāʾan ghayra majdhūdh

ar: فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُهُم مِّن قَبْلُ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنقُوصٍ
en: (109) So do not be in doubt, [O Muḥammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished.
tr: Falā taku fī miryatim mimmā yaʿbudu hāʾulāʾ, mā yaʿbudūna illā kamā yaʿbudu ābāʾuhum min qabl, waʾinnā lamuwaffūhum naṣībahum ghayra manqūṣ

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
en: (110) And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word[579] that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.
enNotes: [579]- See footnote to 10:19.
tr: Walaqad ātaynā mūsal-kitāba fakhtulifa fīh, walawlā kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika laquḍiya baynahum, waʾinnahum lafī shakkim minhu murīb

ar: وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
en: (111) And indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Aware of what they do.
tr: Waʾinna kullal lammā layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka aʿmālahum, innahū bimā yaʿmalūna khabīr

ar: فَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
en: (112) So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allāh], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
tr: Fastaqim kamā umirta waman tāba maʿaka walā taṭghaw, innahū bimā taʿmalūna baṣīr

ar: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ فَتَمَسَّكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
en: (113) And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allāh any protectors; then you would not be helped.
tr: Walā tarkanū ilal-ladhīna ẓalamū fatamassakumun-nāru wamā lakum min dūnillāhi min awliyāʾa thumma lā tunṣarūn

ar: وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَىِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ إِنَّ ٱلْحَسَنَٰتِ يُذْهِبْنَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلذَّٰكِرِينَ
en: (114) And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.
tr: Waʾaqimiṣ-ṣalāta ṭarafayin-nahāri wazulafam minal-layl, innal-ḥasanāti yudhhibnas-sayyiʾāt, dhālika dhikrā lidh-dhākirīn

ar: وَٱصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
en: (115) And be patient, for indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
tr: Waṣbir faʾinnallāha lā yuḍīʿu ajral-muḥsinīn

ar: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْفَسَادِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّنْ أَنجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَآ أُتْرِفُوا۟ فِيهِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
en: (116) So why were there not[580] among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals.
enNotes: [580]- Meaning "If only there had been..."
tr: Falawlā kāna minal-qurūni min qablikum ulū baqiyyatiy yanhawna ʿanil-fasādi fil-arḍi illā qalīlam mimman anjaynā minhum, wattabaʿal-ladhīna ẓalamū mā utrifū fīhi wakānū mujrimīn

ar: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ
en: (117) And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.
tr: Wamā kāna rabbuka liyuhlikal-qurā biẓulmiw waʾahluhā muṣliḥūn

ar: وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ
en: (118) And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ,
tr: Walaw shāʾa rabbuka lajaʿalan-nāsa ummataw wāḥidataw walā yazālūna mukhtalifīn

ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (119) Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together."
tr: Illā mar raḥima rabbuk, walidhālika khalaqahum, watammat kalimatu rabbika laʾamlaʾanna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-nāsi ajmaʿīn

ar: وَكُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ وَجَآءَكَ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (120) And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers.
tr: Wakullan naquṣṣu ʿalayka min ambāʾir-rusuli mā nuthabbitu bihī fuʾādaka wajāʾaka fī hādhihil-ḥaqqu wamawʿiẓatuw wadhikrā lil-muʾminīn

ar: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَٰمِلُونَ
en: (121) And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.
tr: Waqul lilladhīna lā yuʾminūnaʿmalū ʿalā makānatikum, innā ʿāmilūn

ar: وَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
en: (122) And wait; indeed, we are waiting."
tr: Wantaẓirū, innā muntaẓirūn

ar: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ ٱلْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُۥ فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (123) And to Allāh belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do.
tr: Walillāhi ghaybus-samāwāti wal-arḍi waʾilayhi yurjaʿul-amru kulluhū faʿbudhu watawakkal ʿalayh, wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn
